senses.gloss:
जित्, त्, त्, त्, (at the end of a comp.) winning, van-
quishing, conquering, removing (e. g. शत्रु-जित्, van-
quishing enemies); [cf. अनन्त-जित्, अभिमाति-ज्˚,
अश्व-ज्˚, उग्र-ज्˚.] — 1. जित्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, (at end
of comp.) most victorious, first of conquerors; [cf. 2.
जित्तम.]

जित, अस्, आ, अम्, conquered, vanquished, subdued;
surpassed, overcome, subject to, enslaved by (e. g.
काम-जित, under the dominion of lust); won,
gained, obtained; (अस्), m. one of the attendants
upon a Jina or Jaina saint; (a wrong form for अ-जित.)
—जित-काशि, इस्, m. the fist doubled.
—जित-काशिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, appearing victorious.
—जित-कोप or जित-
क्रोध, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has subdued anger,
imperturbable, not to be roused to wrath.
—जित-
क्लम, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has overcome fatigue.
—जित-नेमि, इस्, m. a staff made of the wood of the
religious fig-tree (carried during the performance of
certain vows).
—जित-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, one who
has subdued his wrath; (अस्), m. an epithet of
Viṣṇu.
—जित-लोक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has con-
quered heaven, epithet of a class of manes.
—जित-
वती, f., N. of a daughter of Uśīnara.
—जित-व्रत,
अस्, m., N. of a son of Havir-dhāna.
—जित-शत्रु,
उस्, उस्, उ, one whose enemies are conquered, con-
quering foes, victorious, triumphant; (उस्), m., N. of
a Buddha; the father of A-jita, the second Arhat of
the present Ava-sarpiṇī.
—जित-श्रम, अस्, m. one
who has conquered toil, free from worldly cares, a
stoic.
—जित-स्वर्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has con-
quered or won heaven.
—जिताक्षर (˚त-अक्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, ‘one who has mastered the letters,’ reading
well or readily.
—जितात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, self-
subdued, void of passion; (आ), m., N. of one of the
Viśve-devas.
—जितामित्र (˚त-अम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one
who has conquered an enemy, triumphant, victorious;
(अस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
—जितारि (˚त-अरि),
इस्, इस्, इ, triumphant over an enemy; (इस्), m., N. of
a son of Avikṣit; a Buddha; N. of the father of
Śam-bhava, the third Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī.
—जिताहव (˚त-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
won a battle, victorious, triumphant.
—जिताहार
(˚त-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who by abstraction is able
to do without food.
—जितेन्द्रिय (˚त-इन्˚), अस्, आ,
[]
अम्, one who has conquered his passions or subdued
the senses, calm, impassive, unmoved; (अस्), m. an
ascetic, a sage; N. of a man.
—जितेन्द्रिय-त्व, अम्,
n. subjugation of the senses or passions.
—जितेन्द्रि-
याह्व (˚य-आह्˚), अस्, m., N. of a plant, = काम-
वृद्धि.
जित जित, &c. See under rt. 1. जि.
जीत जीत, &c. See rt. 1. ज्या, p. 352.

जीत or जीन, अस्, आ, अम्, oppressed, overpowered;
become old. See also under जीत, p. 348, col. 1.
जिति, इस्, f. gaining, obtaining, a victory, conquest.
जीति, इस्, f. fading away. See अ-जीति.

जित्य, अस्, आ, अम्, conquerable, vincible; (आ), f.
victory, acquisition, gain; a ploughshare; (अस्), m.
a harrow.

जित्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, victorious; (आ), m., N. of a
man.

जित्वर, अस्, ई, अम्, victorious, triumphant; (ई),
f. ‘Victrix,’ N. of the city Benares.
जित्वा, ind. having conquered or excelled.

जित्तम 2. जित्तम or जितुम or जित्म, अस्,
m. (a word borrowed fr. the Gr. διδύμοι), the sign
of the zodiac Gemini.
